# JS-modules
> Small, dependency-free JavaScript modules and tools for single-file browser games, extracted from Apple Press and Fancy, the Banana. MIT License, Copyright (c) 2026 LFC Foundry.

Each module is one file usable as a browser global or via require(). Start with modules.json (machine-readable index).

Grouped by what each piece does: Games, Story editor, Tools. Every entry in modules.json also carries `side` and `category`.

## Games: Saving and data safety
- [save-kit](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/save-kit/README.md): Safe localStorage saves, backup slot, checksummed copy-paste save codes with a size limit on what a paste may unpack to. (global SaveKit) Version 1.0.0, API 1.

## Games: Device and browser adaptation
- [env-probes](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/env-probes/README.md): Detects privacy modes that round timers (including Firefox's 16.67 ms clock), scramble canvas read-back or block storage, and says what it found in plain words. (global EnvProbes) Version 1.1.0, API 1.
- [fx-governor](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/fx-governor/README.md): Steps visual effects down when the device cannot keep up; never back up behind the player. (global FxGovernor) Version 1.1.0, API 1.
- [frame-kit](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/frame-kit/README.md): Frame pacing for canvas games: even-dt smooths the frame time, quality-governor steps effects down and back up, job-pump spreads heavy jobs across frames, frame-meter shows frames a second, hitches and tap delay in plain words. (global EvenDt, QualityGovernor, JobPump, FrameMeter) Version 1.1.0, API 1.
- [slow-note](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/slow-note/README.md): Keeps a short note, only on the device, of the errors, slow taps and long frames a page had; copyable as plain text, nothing is sent anywhere. Version 1.0.0, API 1.

## Games: Controls
- [hold-press](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/hold-press/README.md): Hold-to-repeat for buttons that survives Android Chrome pointercancel. (global HoldPress) Version 1.0.0, API 1.
- [pad-nav](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/pad-nav/README.md): Gamepad API to DOM focus: move through buttons, menus, sliders and drop-downs with a controller, no game code. (global PadNav) Version 1.0.0, API 1.
- [tab-guard](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/tab-guard/README.md): Keeps one open copy of a page in charge (Web Locks), so two tabs do not overwrite each other's saved data, and tells the game when the other copy closes. (global TabGuard) Version 1.0.0, API 1.
- [wake-keeper](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/wake-keeper/README.md): Keeps the screen awake only while a game wants it: released on pause, hidden tab and idle, asked again when allowed. (global WakeKeeper) Version 1.0.0, API 1.
- [back-close](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/back-close/README.md): Makes the phone back swipe or back button close the top panel instead of leaving the page (CloseWatcher, with an opt-in history fallback for browsers without it). (global BackClose) Version 1.0.0, API 1.

## Games: First visit and grown-ups
- [grown-ups-door](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/grown-ups-door/README.md): A hold-then-drag task a young child will not finish, in front of the buttons and links a grown-up should press (a speed bump, not security). Version 1.0.0, API 1.
- [spotlight-tour](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/spotlight-tour/README.md): A first-time tour: one dimmed layer, a bright window over the current part, Skip and Back, remembers who saw it and gives a finishing gift once. Version 1.0.0, API 1.

## Games: Looks and effects
- [stage-curtains](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/stage-curtains/README.md): Velvet stage curtains that slide shut over a page, then fly open. (global StageCurtains) Version 1.0.0, API 1.
- [fly-to-mini](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/fly-to-mini/README.md): A big element scrolls away and a copy flies to its sticky mini version (and back). (global FlyToMini) Version 1.2.0, API 1.
- [sticker-text](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/sticker-text/README.md): Die-cut sticker lettering in plain CSS text-shadow rings, no images. (global StickerText) Version 1.0.0, API 1.
- [sprite-baker](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/sprite-baker/README.md): Tiny software 3D rasterizer that bakes shaded sprites to canvases once at load, or one frame per tick; also makes silhouette masks and packs sprite sheets. (global SpriteBaker) Version 1.2.0, API 1.
- [cartoon-3d-kit](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/cartoon-3d-kit/README.md): A written style guide plus demo for the soft, glossy cartoon 3D look done in plain CSS and SVG. Version 1.0.0, API 1.

## Games: Game math
- [idle-core](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/idle-core/README.md): Tested maths for idle/clicker games: costs, buy-many and buy-max, milestones, away income, boost queue, number format. (global IdleCore) Version 1.1.0, API 1.

## Games: Size and packaging
- [lzma-decode](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/lzma-decode/README.md): Small readable LZMA1 decoder (ES5), tested against Python's lzma. Browsers can only unpack gzip and deflate natively. (global lzmaDecode) Version 1.0.0, API 1.
- [ppmd-decode](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/ppmd-decode/README.md): A PPMd (7-Zip PPMd7) decoder in one ES5 function, about 6.6 KB packed. It unpacks web-page data about 10% smaller than LZMA, but about 4 times slower. PPMd is by Dmitry Shkarin; the public-domain code it follows is Igor Pavlov's, from 7-Zip. (global ppmd7Decode) Version 1.0.0, API 1.

## Games: Files, charts and simulation
- [gif-writer](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/gif-writer/README.md): Writes animated GIFs from canvas pictures with one shared palette, storing only the pixels that changed (about 6.8 times smaller than gifenc on a mostly still animation). Version 1.0.0, API 1.
- [zip-open](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/zip-open/README.md): Opens .zip and Excel .xlsx files safely: limits counted on what really unpacks, so a zip bomb stops at the limit with a plain-words note. Version 1.0.0, API 1.
- [river-layout](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/river-layout/README.md): Lays out a flow chart (Sankey) from a plain list of links, with about half the weighted crossings of d3-sankey on the charts measured, backward links drawn instead of crashing, and an SVG drawer. Version 1.0.0, API 1.
- [walker-sim](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules/walker-sim/README.md): Simulates random walkers on a network with seeded, repeatable runs, 16 random-number distributions, 95% ranges and the exact odds to check against (about 1.75 million walkers a second). Version 1.0.0, API 1.

## Story editor: Story data (in https://github.com/lfcfoundry/story-editor, generated from the Story Editor's sources)
- [story-format](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/story-editor/blob/main/packages/story-format/README.md): Create, clean, search, import and export interactive stories as JSON, with a JSON Schema. Twine import lives in twine-import.
- [twine-import](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/story-editor/blob/main/packages/twine-import/README.md): Reads Twine stories (Twine 2 HTML, Twee 3, Twine 1) and turns SugarCube and Harlowe code into rules, with a plain-words report.
- [story-outline](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/story-editor/blob/main/packages/story-outline/README.md): Turns an indented outline into pages and choices, or into a whole branching story.
- [story-diff](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/story-editor/blob/main/packages/story-diff/README.md): Says in plain words what one edit did to a story, such as "Add page “The Cellar”".

## Story editor: Checking (in https://github.com/lfcfoundry/story-editor, generated from the Story Editor's sources)
- [story-check](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/story-editor/blob/main/packages/story-check/README.md): Exact checker for branching stories with items, numbers and dice: dead ends and endings no player can reach.

## Story editor: Drawing (in https://github.com/lfcfoundry/story-editor, generated from the Story Editor's sources)
- [story-map](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/story-editor/blob/main/packages/story-map/README.md): Layered, arc and matrix drawings of a story graph (SVG) and seeded simulated players.

## Story editor: Playing and building (in https://github.com/lfcfoundry/story-editor, generated from the Story Editor's sources)
- [story-player](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/story-editor/blob/main/packages/story-player/README.md): Build one offline HTML game from a story, or play a story from code or a terminal.

## Tools for games: Size and packaging
- [lzma-pack](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/tools/lzma-pack/README.md): Packs one HTML file into a smaller self-unpacking file with LZMA and a hash check (Python 3 standard library). Version 1.0.0, API 1.
- [ppmd-pack](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/tools/ppmd-pack/README.md): Packs one HTML file into a self-unpacking file with PPMd, the 7-Zip text compressor (PPMd by Dmitry Shkarin; public-domain code by Igor Pavlov, 7-Zip). Pure Python; pays off above about 60 KB of compressed data. Version 1.0.0, API 1.
- [single-file-tools](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/tools/single-file-tools/README.md): Font subsetting, safe inline-SVG tightening and a Zopfli self-extracting packer for one-file games. Version 1.1.0, API 1.

## Tools for games: Testing
- [fuzz-kit](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/tools/fuzz-kit/README.md): Seeded, reproducible random-input fuzzer engine with weighted operations, invariants, liveness checks and failure shrinking; Playwright and Puppeteer runners with real input and CPU throttling; stock-Firefox recipe; test-hook stripper. Version 1.1.0, API 1.
- [canvas-probe](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/tools/canvas-probe/README.md): Test-build counter for canvas 2D games: calls per frame, save/restore leaks, overhanging drawImage sources, draws below half size, style-write repeats, painted area. Version 1.1.0, API 1.
- [storage-probe](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/tools/storage-probe/README.md): Page that tells you in plain words whether copies of a page saved in different folders share their saved data, see each other's writes and locks; one button, copyable report. Version 1.1.0, API 1.
- [firefox-stand-in](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/tools/firefox-stand-in/README.md): Runs a Playwright-for-Python test in stock Firefox (through Selenium and geckodriver) without rewriting it; says plainly which calls it supports and stops with a clear message on the rest. Version 1.0.0, API 1.
- [test-isolation](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/tools/test-isolation/README.md): Puts a prefix in front of every localStorage key on a test page, so a speed test or random-play run never touches the real saved game. Version 1.0.0, API 1.
- [speed-lab](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/tools/speed-lab/README.md): One-button speed test run on the device: compares your page with parts switched off, keeps the scene in view and uncovered, and says the answer in plain sentences with a copyable table. Version 1.0.0, API 1.
- [webkit-driver](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/tools/webkit-driver/README.md) 1.0.0 · API 1: Drives WebKitGTK or GNOME Web from Node with no dependencies, using the call names of Playwright and Puppeteer (goto, evaluate, waitForFunction, mouse, keyboard, screenshot, console errors), so a test written for them can also run in WebKit.

## Tools for the story editor: Size and packaging
- [zip-page](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/story-editor/blob/main/packages/zip-page/README.md): Wrap a finished HTML page into a smaller page that unzips itself, with a pure-JS inflater fallback.

## Tools for the story editor: Testing
- [qa-kit](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/story-editor/blob/main/packages/qa-kit/README.md): Tiered test runner and a Playwright-style API over WebDriver BiDi for stock Firefox; seeded random-story generator.
- [contract-kit](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/story-editor/blob/main/packages/contract-kit/README.md): A guide and a small helper for keeping two implementations of one rule set from drifting apart: seeded random inputs, a side-by-side comparison, a field table and a time limit.

## Tools for the story editor: Working with an AI helper
- [ai-collab-kit](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/story-editor/blob/main/packages/ai-collab-kit/README.md): A written process and templates for a person and an AI assistant building software together.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/README.md): overview and install
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules for AI assistants editing this repo
- [modules.json](https://github.com/lfcfoundry/JS-modules/blob/main/modules.json): index with files, globals and demo paths
- Test browsers: only those on the `browsers` branch of the private knowledge-base repository: Firefox 158, ungoogled Chromium 155 and WebKitGTK 2.52.6 (Linux), one at a time; re-read that branch's README before each run and label results with the exact version. Chromium 141 and 153 and Firefox 157 are retired. Every module's README and changelog entry has a "Tested in" line naming the browsers used. Real phones and Safari itself are not checked yet. See the Tests section of the README and AGENTS.md.
